id.description: A word of lower-case letters and digits, 1 to 32, that no built-in type uses.

title.description: The type's name in the plural, for the Store's index.

icon.description: The name of one of the application's icons, or a small image the extension ships as a `data:image/png;base64,...` or `data:image/webp;base64,...` address (at most [`MAX_ICON_TEXT`] characters), or none for the default icon. A name the application does not know draws the default.

stores.description: The `program_store` providers the type lists, in order.
